metadata.note: ICD-10-CM codes in codes/data/icd-10-cm.yaml with the CMS long description (Issue #3127). billable = the order file's header flag (1 = valid for HIPAA-covered transactions). Codes missing from the source are WHO-only or retired codes the registry still lists; they are not emitted for the US.
